name: 2024-2c-parcial2
title: Pacman Prototype
description: A simplified Pacman: a pacman and two ghosts move on a walled board eating pills, with lives, score, tick-delayed ghosts that pick random directions at walls, and a game-over condition. The student must build the whole game model on top of a given StringPacmanBoard that parses and visits a string representation of the board, and must produce that representation back for the tests.

design.notes: A heterogeneous board of walls, pills, spaces, ghosts and pacman built through a visitor, where ghosts must remember what they cover, start after different tick counts and choose directions from a random 1-5 mapping, plus lives, score and game-over; the reference solution itself had a ghost-over-pill game-over bug, showing how subtle the element/collision model is.
